assumptions.emulator: Emulator runs use Clifford-rounding: non-Clifford angles are rounded to the nearest pi/2 multiple.
assumptions.physicalOperations: The supplied column is Physical ops (w/o move). Retain this movement-excluded count; it is not a total including all physical transport.
assumptions.interpretation: QDK's neutral-atom model represents atom transport with PHYSICAL_MOVE, separately from the SWAP instruction. The producing report and exact exclusion filter were not supplied: do not assume that w/o move excludes all SWAP/routing gates, or derive runtime from this count.
assumptions.correctness: Clifford-rounded emulator runs do not by themselves establish correctness for the original non-Clifford circuits.
assumptions.history: The supplied tables contain one snapshot per candidate, dated September 4, 2026 as confirmed by the user. Earlier historical points, runtime models, targets, owners and completion dates were not supplied.
